_doc: THE subagent model-choice rules, and the facts they rest on. hooks/claude/agent_guard.py enforces `tiers`, `exempt_agent_types` and `exploration`; scripts/agent_audit.py prices the ledger with `facts.price.*` and judges with `verdict`; scripts/model_choice_watch.py re-checks every fact's `check` against its source each week and marks the facts that no longer match (and the tiers resting on them) `re-research` in its findings. Nothing else restates these values (tests/test_model_choice_rules.py). Every value here is the OWNER's: the audit and the watch PROPOSE changes with their numbers, and nothing writes this file but a person (owner ruling 2026-10-18). The decision and its evidence: ~/.claude/skills/agent-fanout/references/model-choice-decision.md.

sonnet@low.why: Claude Code's medium is Sonnet's measured weak spot (62.7% vs 77.8% at high)

sonnet@medium.why: Claude Code's medium is Sonnet's measured weak spot (62.7% vs 77.8% at high)

sonnet@xhigh.why: Sonnet at xhigh/max costs more than Opus for less

exempt_agent_types.why: read-only lookups and meta agents, and `fork`, which ignores `model`: none lands commits, so they need no model and get no contract; their spawns are still ledgered

pool_first.decided: owner 2026-10-25: read-only bulk work and checkable edits go through token-pool's `ask` (~/Projects/token-pool: free Zen, agy and Gemini quota) BEFORE a Claude subagent is spawned for them. A spawn on these tiers says which in its prompt: `Pool: tried <what ask returned>` (escalate_to_caller, a failed proof) or `Pool: unfit because <reason>` (the work needs this repo's files or tools, which pool's backends never see: they get the prompt alone). The ledger keeps the line, so a habit of `unfit` shows up as data.

cheap_alternation.decided: owner 2026-10-18 (goh model-choice improvement loop, item 3): a checkable + known-fix spawn runs on whichever cheap tier the parity of its prompt's sha picks, so the two are compared on the same kind of work

opus_to_cheap.decided: OWNER DECISION PENDING (2026-10-18): default OFF. When on, this fraction of opus@medium spawns that declare `checkable` (and not `unchecked`) run on the cheap tier instead; escalation bounds the cost. A spawn without a mechanical check is never routed down, on or off.

verdict.rule: a cheap class holds while its redo rate < 1 - (its cost per attempt / the escalation class's cost per attempt); cost = the ledger's tokens x facts.price.<model>
